title: Compatibility of a descended morphism with its descent datum
statement: Let a:X→S and r:X′→X be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with r a singleton fpqc covering [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. Let F:DD(a)→DD(r≫a) [def-galois-scheme-descent-data-category] and q_A exhibit cartesian squares [def-pc-fibre-product] and base change of the data [def-pd-descent-datum]. For A,B, β:F(A)→F(B) and any X-morphism α:A.V→B.V satisfying q_A≫α.left=β.hom.left≫q_B, α commutes with transport for every test scheme, pair f₀,f₁ with equal images in S, and point z of A over f₀.

source.place: 0241, final verification of the descent-data compatibility

proof.text: For a test scheme T with f0,f1:T→X, form P=T×_{X,f0}X′ and Q=P×_{X,p≫f1}X′. Write g:Q→T for the composite projections, and x0,x1:Q→X′ for the two lifts. The pullback equations give g≫fi=xi≫r. Use the cartesian square for A to lift g≫z.left to v:Q→F(A).V.left over x0. This is a genuine pullback lift, with v≫q_A=g≫z.left.

Apply the base-change transport equations for A to v and for B to v≫β.hom.left. Reconstruction hα identifies their images with g≫z.left and g≫z.left≫α.left. Compose β.commutes with q_B; associativity and hα identify its right side with the A transport followed by α. Naturality of both descent data along g converts this into equality of the two required morphisms after precomposition by g. Equal test points and their Over morphisms are identified by substitution and Over morphism extensionality.

Both projections Q→P and P→T are singleton fpqc covers by Mathlib Precoverage.mem_coverings_of_isPullback. For any singleton fpqc cover f, fpqcTopology.Subcanonical gives isSheafFor for every representable on the generated covering sieve. Presieve.EffectiveEpimorphic.iff_forall_isSheafFor_yoneda and Sieve.effectiveEpimorphic_singleton therefore give EffectiveEpi f and hence Epi f. Cancel the two projections successively using cancel_epi, then use Over morphism extensionality. This uses only injectivity of representable descent, not existence of a descended morphism.

proof_origin.note: C1: complete Lean proof by explicit double test-point refinement, pullback lift, transport naturality and cancellation. Mathlib fpqc subcanonicity supplies the injectivity directly; no import of the full morphism descent theorem is needed.

lean.statement: theorem fpqc_descent_morphism_compatibility {S X X' : Scheme.{u}} (a : X ⟶ S) (r : X' ⟶ X) (hr : Presieve.singleton r ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage X) (F : Over.DescentDataCategory a ⥤ Over.DescentDataCategory (r ≫ a)) (q : ∀ A : Over.DescentDataCategory a, (F.obj A).V.left ⟶ A.V.left) (hq : ∀ A, ∃ hq : q A ≫ A.V.hom = (F.obj A).V.hom ≫ r, IsPullback (q A) (F.obj A).V.hom A.V.hom r ∧ Over.DescentDatum.IsBaseChange rfl hq A.datum (F.obj A).datum) (A B : Over.DescentDataCategory a) (β : F.obj A ⟶ F.obj B) (α : A.V ⟶ B.V) (hα : q A ≫ α.left = β.hom.left ≫ q B) : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₀ f₁ : T ⟶ X) (h : f₀ ≫ a = f₁ ≫ a) (z : Over.mk f₀ ⟶ A.V), B.datum.transport f₀ f₁ h (z ≫ α) = A.datum.transport f₀ f₁ h z ≫ α
